payload.name: acceptance_criteria
payload.value:
When basicly worktree cleanup removes a lane, then it also deletes the lane's branch on origin when the base branch on origin holds every path that branch changed (its landed content is on origin), and it keeps the branch and names why when that proof is missing
When basicly worktree merge --mode ci ends by success, refusal or failure, then no land/LANE/N branch it pushed stays on origin
When a lane is replaced by a lane that landed, then cleanup of the replaced lane deletes its local and remote branch on that proof
